model NewsRequest {
  id          String            @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId      String            @map("user_id")
  date        DateTime          @db.Date
  location    String?
  latitude    Float?
  longitude   Float?
  scope       NewsScope
  searchQuery Json              @map("search_query")
  status      NewsRequestStatus
  error       String?           @db.Text
  storyCount  Int               @default(5) @map("story_count")
  categories  String[]          @default([])
  customQuery String?           @map("custom_query") @db.Text
  language    String?
  sources     String[]          @default([])
  createdAt   DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  completedAt DateTime?         @map("completed_at")
  isRerunning Boolean           @default(false) @map("is_rerunning")
  isEdition   Boolean           @default(false) @map("is_edition")
  newsEdition NewsEdition?

  user        User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  stories     NewsStory[]
  loadingLogs String[]    @default([]) @map("loading_logs")

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("news_requests")
}

model NewsStory {
  id              String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  newsRequestId   String?       @map("news_request_id") @db.Uuid
  chatSessionId   String?       @map("chat_session_id") @db.Uuid
  ownerId         String?       @map("owner_id")
  isUserCreated   Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_user_created")
  publishStatus   PublishStatus @default(published) @map("publish_status")
  generationError String?       @map("generation_error") @db.Text
  title           String
  description     String?
  slug            String
  summary         String        @db.Text
  content         String        @db.Text
  category        String
  location        String?
  publishedAt     DateTime?     @map("published_at")
  importanceScore Decimal?      @map("importance_score") @db.Decimal(10, 4)
  rank            Int?
  upvotes         Int           @default(0)
  downvotes       Int           @default(0)
  createdAt       DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  newsSourceIds   String[]      @default([]) @map("news_source_ids") @db.Uuid
  imageUrl        String?       @map("image_url") @db.Text
  loadingLogs     String[]      @default([]) @map("loading_logs")

  newsRequest       NewsRequest?    @relation(fields: [newsRequestId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  originChatSession ChatSession?    @relation("ChatStoryOrigin", fields: [chatSessionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  owner             User?           @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  sources           NewsSource[]
  chatSessions      ChatSession[]   @relation("ChatSessionLinkedStory")
  votes             NewsStoryVote[]

  @@unique([newsRequestId, slug])
  @@index([newsRequestId])
  @@index([newsRequestId, rank])
  @@index([chatSessionId])
  @@index([ownerId])
  @@index([isUserCreated, publishStatus])
  @@index([ownerId, publishStatus])
  @@index([upvotes, publishedAt])
  @@map("news_stories")
}

model NewsSource {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  newsStoryId    String    @map("news_story_id") @db.Uuid
  url            String    @db.Text
  domain         String
  title          String
  scrapedContent String?   @map("scraped_content") @db.Text
  publishedAt    DateTime? @map("published_at")
  sourceType     String    @map("source_type")
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  transcript     String?   @db.Text
  imageUrl       String?   @map("image_url") @db.Text

  newsStory NewsStory @relation(fields: [newsStoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([newsStoryId])
  @@map("news_sources")
}

enum VoteType {
  UP
  DOWN

  @@map("vote_type")
}

model Script {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  chatSessionId     String   @map("chat_session_id") @db.Uuid
  title             String
  content           String   @db.Text
  durationSeconds   Int?     @map("duration_seconds")
  style             String?
  status            String
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  researchSourceIds String[] @default([]) @map("research_source_ids") @db.Uuid

  user        User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  chatSession ChatSession @relation(fields: [chatSessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([chatSessionId])
  @@map("scripts")
}

/**
 * Inngest function registry
 *
 * All durable workflows register in `inngestFunctions` and are served from
 * `app/api/inngest`.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * User-facing research pipelines
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * newsPipelineFunction (`newsPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `news/pipeline.requested`
 *
 * newsRerunPipelineFunction (`reRunPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `news/pipeline.rerun.requested`
 *   Data: `{ newsId }` — `NewsRequest` UUID; runs only when `isRerunning` is true.
 *   Outcome: Incremental Serp/YouTube discovery since last completion; may update existing
 *   stories, add sources, or create net-new stories; clears `isRerunning`; rerun completion
 *   notification. Does not re-run the full initial briefing or flip request to `failed` on error.
 *   Agents: StoryMatcher, StoryUpdateDecision, NewsSynthesizer (+ shared news scrape agents).
 *   See file header for step-by-step rerun semantics and dedupe boundary.
 *
 * chatPipelineFunction (`newsNewchatPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `chat/pipeline.requested`
 *   Input: `userId`, `chatSessionId`, `userMessageId`
 *   Outcome: First turn on story-anchored / deep-dive session — research prompt from
 *   story + sources, Serp, scrape, ChatModel reply. No pgvector recall.
 *
 * messageChatPipelineFunction (`chatPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `chat/message.research.requested`
 *   Input: `chatSessionId`, `chatMessageId`, optional `shouldCreateStory`
 *   Outcome: General follow-up chat — determiner, vector/Serp/YouTube, Firecrawl,
 *   assistant Markdown OR handoff to chat story pipeline. Idempotent per message.
 *   Enqueues potential story topics after normal replies.
 *
 * chatStoryPipelineFunction (`chatstoryPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `chat/story.research.requested`
 *   Input: `ChatStoryPipelineEventData` (prepared research from message chat)
 *   Outcome: One PENDING → READY user `NewsStory` + sources; gap agent for extra work.
 *   Idempotent per `storyId`.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Background workers (fire-and-forget enqueue)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * researchSourceDescriptionFunction (`researchSourceDescriptionPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `research/source.index.requested`
 *   Enqueue: `createResearchSource` → `enqueueResearchSourceIndexing`
 *   Outcome: Description on `ResearchSource` + pgvector row for session similarity.
 *
 * chatMessageEmbeddingFunction (`chatMessageEmbeddingPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `chat/message.index.requested`
 *   Enqueue: `createChatMessage` → `enqueueChatMessageVectorIndexing`
 *   Outcome: Memory summary + `chat_message_embeddings` for conversational recall.
 *
 * chatPotentialStoryTopicsFunction (`chatPotentialStoryTopicsPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `chat/potential-story-topics.requested`
 *   Enqueue: message chat pipeline `step.sendEvent` after assistant reply
 *   Outcome: Append deduped labels to `ChatSession.potentialStories` (0–5 new).
 *   Idempotent per `chatMessageId`.
 *
 * stockResearchPipelineFunction (`stockResearch/stockResearchPipeline.ts`)
 *   Event: `stock/research.requested`
 *   Enqueue: `POST /api/stockResearch` (creates PENDING `StockResearch`)
 *   Outcome: Prompt enhancer → tool determiner → Upstox + Serp → link selector →
 *   Firecrawl → `StockResearchResource` rows → Markdown report, status COMPLETED.
 *
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Typical chat flow (general session)
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 *   POST /api/chat/[id] → chat/message.research.requested
 *        → ResearchSource inserts → research/source.index.requested (each)
 *        → agent message → chat/message.index.requested
 *        → chat/potential-story-topics.requested (optional)
 *
 *   User “Create story…” → shouldCreateStory → chat/story.research.requested
 */

export {
  NEWS_PIPELINE_EVENT,
  newsPipelineEventDataSchema,
  newsPipelineFunction,
  type NewsPipelineEventData,
} from "./newsPipeline";

export {

} from "./chatMessageEmbeddingPipeline";

export {

  enqueueStockResearchPipeline,
  type StockResearchPipelineEventData,
} from "./stockResearch/stockResearchPipeline";

];

// Prisma loads every file in db/schema automatically.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../generated"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  clerkId               String    @unique
  email                 String    @unique
  firstName             String?
  lastName              String?
  username              String?
  imageUrl              String?
  hasImage              Boolean   @default(false)
  primaryEmailAddressId String?
  lastSignInAt          DateTime?
  lastActiveAt          DateTime?
  banned                Boolean   @default(false)
  locked                Boolean   @default(false)
  twoFactorEnabled      Boolean   @default(false)
  locale                String?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
  savedStories          String[]  @default([]) @map("saved_stories") @db.Uuid
  plan                  UserPlan  @default(FREE)

  newsRequests     NewsRequest[]
  chatSessions     ChatSession[]
  scripts          Script[]
  newsStoryVotes   NewsStoryVote[]
  notifications    Notification[]
  ownedNewsStories NewsStory[]
  subscription     Subscription?
  payments         Payment[]
enum UserPlan {
  FREE
  PRO

  @@map("user_plan")
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  TRIALING
  PAST_DUE
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED

  @@map("subscription_status")
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  CREATED
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
  REFUNDED

  @@map("payment_status")
}

enum WebhookEventStatus {
  PENDING
  PROCESSED

<pasted_content id="71da">
# Task: "Video script" pipeline for individual news pages (Dainik Samachar)

From a news item, generate a researched, fact-checked talking-head video script, creative/editing
direction, image results, optional AI prompts, a publishing kit, and a hand-off pack that a local AI
CLI turns into a finished video with Remotion. Triggered by a button on the news page; results on
`/news/[id]/script`.

## Read first
Read `prisma/schema.prisma` (news model + its source/article relations), the individual news page
(`/news/[id]`), `inngest/` (client, index, functions), `lib/clients/` (OpenAI, SerpApi, Firecrawl,
any web search client), Clerk setup and existing agent conventions BEFORE coding. Reuse them; do not
duplicate models or clients. Ask me if the news page route is not `/news/[id]`.

## Docs (fetch before use; STOP and ask if unclear — never guess endpoints, params or fields)
- Inngest v4: https://www.inngest.com/docs/reference/typescript/v4/intro
- OpenAI structured outputs: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs
- OpenAI image generation (to write prompt SUGGESTIONS only): https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/image-generation
- SerpApi Google Images: https://serpapi.com/google-images-api
- SerpApi Google Images Light: https://serpapi.com/google-images-light-api
- SerpApi Bing Images: https://serpapi.com/bing-images-api
- SerpApi Google News: https://serpapi.com/google-news-api
- Optional: Pexels (photos + videos) https://www.pexels.com/api/documentation/ ,
  Wikimedia Commons API https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php
- Remotion: https://www.remotion.dev/docs/

## Hard rules
1. Every agent: `agents/video/<name>/{schema.ts, prompt.ts, index.ts, <name>.test.ts}`; zod input AND
   output, validate both; export PROMPT_VERSION; never throw — return status "failed" + reason.
2. Facts come ONLY from the FactSheet (built from the news row and its sources). Nothing from model memory.
   No investment advice. Finance stories carry "For information only, not investment advice."
3. The pipeline NEVER generates images or videos. AI prompts are optional suggestions only.
4. Not every beat needs a visual. Empty beats are fine.
5. Every external call goes through the existing call wrapper (cache, retry, budget) if the repo has one;
   otherwise create `lib/clients/callTool.ts` (cache by hash, retries 1s/2s/4s, per-run budget, returns null on failure).
6. Idempotent: re-clicking returns the existing script unless "Regenerate" is used.
7. AI prompt suggestions: no real identifiable people, no real logos/trademarks, no fake documents or headlines.

---

## PHASE 1 — Data model + trigger + page shell
### Prisma
```prisma
model VideoScript {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  newsId         String   // FK to the existing news model (use its real name/type + relation)
  userId         String
  status         String   // queued | researching | scripting | fact_checking | directing | finding_images | prompting | packaging | building | done | failed
  error          String?
  language       String   // "hi" | "en"
  minSec         Int      @default(60)
  maxSec         Int      @default(140)   // soft limit (±10%)
  pace           String   @default("normal") // slow | normal | fast
  aspectRatio    String   @default("9:16")   // "9:16" | "16:9"
  estimatedSec   Int?
  lengthReason   String?
  research       Json?    // FactSheet
  script         Json?    // ScriptOutput
  factCheck      Json?
  direction      Json?    // CreativeDirection
  publishing     Json?    // PublishingKit
  editPack       Json?
  recordingBrief String?  // markdown
  renderPrompt   String?  // markdown (tool-neutral body)
  promptVersions Json?    // { agentName: version }
  assets         VisualAsset[]
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt
  @@index([newsId])
}
model VisualAsset {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  scriptId   String
  script     VideoScript @relation(fields: [scriptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  beatIndex  Int
  kind       String  // image | video | ai_image_prompt | ai_video_prompt
  source     String? // google_images | google_images_light | bing_images | pexels | wikimedia
  url        String?
  previewUrl String?
  pageUrl    String?
  title      String?
  prompt     String?
  meta       Json?
  rank       Int
}
```
Migrate.
### API (Clerk-protected, zod-validated)
- `POST /api/news/[id]/script` body `{ language?, maxSec?: 30–180, pace?, aspectRatio?, regenerate? }`
  → create or reuse VideoScript → send Inngest event `video/script.requested { scriptId }` → `{ scriptId }`.
- `GET /api/news/[id]/script` → latest VideoScript + assets grouped by beat.
### UI shell
- `/news/[id]`: "Create video script" button at the top with an options popover
  (language Hindi/English, pace slow/normal/fast, max length default 2:20, 9:16 / 16:9) → POST → go to `/news/[id]/script`.
- `/news/[id]/script`: TanStack Query polling GET every 2s until done/failed; status stepper
  (Research → Script → Fact check → Direction → Images → Prompts → Publishing → Edit pack); error view.
- Inngest function `inngest/functions/generateVideoScript.ts` registered in `inngest/index.ts`, with
  stub steps that only update status. onFailure → status failed + error.
CHECKPOINT: click the button on a real news item, see the run move through statuses in the Inngest Dev
Server and on the page. Commit.

## PHASE 2 — Research + script + fact check
### researchBuilder
Input: whole news row + its stored sources (existing models).
1. Collect stored source texts; fetch missing full text via the Firecrawl client (max 5 pages, cached).
2. If fewer than 2 usable sources OR the news is older than 48h: 1–3 extra searches (SerpApi Google News;
   other existing web-search client if available) for latest update/background; fetch ≤ 3 new pages;
   store as sources with URLs.
3. Output FactSheet:
```ts
{ facts: [{ id, text, type: "number"|"date"|"name"|"event"|"quote"|"context", value?, sourceIds: string[],
            sourceUrls: string[], confidence: "high"|"medium" }],
  whatHappened, whatChanged, whyItMatters: string[], whoIsAffected: string[], openQuestions: string[],
  conflicts: [{ factA, factB, note }] }
```
Quotes verbatim with speaker; numbers exactly as in the source (unit, currency); conflicts recorded, never picked silently.
### scriptWriter
- Input: FactSheet + news row + `{ language, minSec, maxSec, pace, aspectRatio }`.
- Length from content, never padded: thin (≤ 6 strong facts) ~60–75s; normal ~90–120s; rich up to ~140s.
  Output `estimatedSec` + `lengthReason`.
- Words/sec (configurable constants): English slow 2.0 / normal 2.4 / fast 2.8; Hindi 1.9 / 2.2 / 2.6.
  Beat start/end from cumulative words ÷ wps.
- Structure: hook (≤ 5s: surprising number, question or consequence) → what happened → key numbers →
  why it matters / who's affected → what to watch next → CTA (≤ 5s). 8–18 beats.
- Output: `{ title, hookOptions: string[3], beats: [{ index, startSec, endSec, spokenText, onScreenText? (≤ 6 words),
  kind: "fact"|"explain", factIds: string[], priority: "core"|"optional", cutNote? }], cta, wordCount, estimatedSec, lengthReason }`.
  Mark extra beats "optional" so the creator can cut. Conversational, one person talking to camera.
### factChecker
- Every number, date, name, quote in each beat must match a FactSheet fact (normalise formats like
  ₹1,200 cr = 1200 crore). Output `{ beats: [{ index, status: "ok"|"fixed"|"removed_claim", issues }], passed }`.
- Failing sentences: rewrite once using only FactSheet facts, re-check; unfixable claims removed. Never add facts.
- Unit test: every number in the final script exists in the FactSheet.
### UI
Tabs "Script" (beats, times, optional badges, fact chips linking to facts, fact-check badge, hook options,
estimatedSec + lengthReason in the header, Copy script) and "Fact sheet" (facts with source links,
conflicts highlighted, open questions).
CHECKPOINT: one thin story → ~1:00–1:15; one rich story → ~2:00–2:20; fact check passes. Commit.

## PHASE 3 — Creative direction (senior content creator + professional editor)
### creativeDirector
Input: script + FactSheet + aspectRatio. Output per beat:
`{ index, needsVisual, overlayType: "none"|"image"|"logo"|"chart"|"text_card"|"video_broll"|"map",
   searchQueries: string[] (≤ 3; only for image/logo/video_broll),
   editing: { transitionIn, transitionOut, motion, textAnimation?, speakerFraming: "normal"|"punch-in 115%",
              sfx?, musicCue? }, editorNote }`
plus global `{ pacing, hookTreatment, subtitleStyle, colorTreatment, musicMood }`.
Apply pro rules, e.g.: company first named → name callout + logo reveal from behind the speaker (scale + slide);
numbers → animated count-up chart/text card, not a photo; change visual every 3–6s in dense parts; punch-in on
key lines; leave beats without overlays when the speaker alone is stronger; hook gets the strongest visual.
### UI
Per beat: editor note + editing chips; global direction card.
CHECKPOINT: every beat has editing direction; some beats have no visual. Commit.

## PHASE 4 — Images + optional AI prompts
### imageFinder (any source, no licence filter)
- image/logo beats: SerpApi Google Images → Google Images Light → Bing Images (next only if < 3 usable results);
  Pexels/Wikimedia only if keys exist. video_broll: Pexels Videos if `PEXELS_API_KEY`, else skip.
- ≤ 6 candidates per beat (cache 7 days, budget); LLM ranks by relevance (text only); keep top 4.
  Logos: prefer official logo / press-kit results. Store URLs only, never download.
### genPrompter (optional)
Only for beats with needsVisual AND (no good result OR director prefers generative).
Per beat: 1–3 image prompts + 0–2 video prompts
`{ kind, prompt, negativePrompt?, style, aspectRatio, durationSec?, cameraMove?, notes }`, tool-neutral
(OpenAI or any image/video model).
### UI
Per beat: image cards (preview, source, open page) + collapsible "AI suggestions (optional)" with Copy buttons.
CHECKPOINT: image beats show results; prompts only where needed. Commit.

## PHASE 5 — Publishing kit
### publishingKit
Input: final script + FactSheet + direction + language. Output:
```ts
{ titles: [{ text, style: "curiosity"|"direct"|"number"|"question"|"hindi_english_mix", charCount }], // 5, ≤ 70 chars preferred
  thumbnail: { concepts: [{ idea, textOverlay /* ≤ 4 words */, layout }], // 3
               openaiPrompts: [{ prompt, size, notes }], // 2–3; background/scene only, leaving space for the creator's face from a video frame
               tips: string[] },
  descriptions: { youtube /* summary, key points, "Sources:" URLs from FactSheet, "Chapters:" placeholder, disclaimer */,
                  shorts /* ≤ 2 lines */, instagram, x /* ≤ 280 chars */ },
  hashtags: string[] /* 5–10 */, pinnedComment: string }
```
Titles/thumbnails must not claim anything the script doesn't say.
### UI
Tab "Publishing kit": titles with char counts, hook options, thumbnail concepts + Copy prompt,
descriptions per platform with Copy, hashtags, pinned comment.
CHECKPOINT: kit complete for one story. Commit.

## PHASE 6 — Hand-off pack, render prompt, static setup guide
### editPackBuilder
- `editPack` (zod-validated):
```ts
{ version: 1, newsId, title, language, aspectRatio, fps: 30, maxSec,
  speaker: { clip: "speaker.mp4", placement: "bottom", headSafeZone: "top 45%" },
  global: { pacing, subtitleStyle, colorTreatment, musicMood, hookTreatment },
  beats: [{ index, scriptText, priority, factIds,

entries.description:
Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model.

- Fails on authenticated/private URLs — use an authenticated MCP tool or `gh` for those instead. claude.ai artifact links (claude.ai/artifact/{id} or claude.ai/code/artifact/{uuid}) are published artifacts: read them with the Artifact tool (action "read"), not WebFetch or curl.
- Fails on localhost and other hostnames without a dot; for a local server, use curl via Bash.
- HTTP is upgraded to HTTPS. Cross-host redirects are returned to you rather than followed; call again with the redirect URL.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL.

- Enums: "A schema may have up to 1000 enum values across all enum properties."
- Large string enums: "the total string length of all enum values cannot exceed 15,000 characters when there are more than 250 enum values."

export const PROMPT_VERSION = "v1";

export const AUDIT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = [
  "You are a strict fact checker for a news video script. The fact sheet is the ONLY truth.",
  "For each beat, list every claim that is not supported by a fact in the fact sheet:",
  "- names of people, companies, places or organisations not in the facts, or attached to the wrong fact;",
  "- dates, days or years that differ from the facts;",
  "- quotes that are not verbatim (or attributed to the wrong speaker);",
  "- events, causes or consequences the facts do not state;",
  "- any investment advice, recommendation or prediction.",
  "Formatting differences are fine (₹1,200 cr = 1200 crore; Hindi vs English wording; translation of a fact).",
  "Framing lines with no factual claim (\"Here's what happened\", \"Follow for more\") are fine.",
  "For each issue copy the exact offending words from the beat into `span` (verbatim, short) and explain in `problem`.",
  "Return every beat index you were given; use an empty issues list when the beat is fine.",
].join("\n");

export function buildRewriteSystemPrompt(language: "hi" | "en"): string {
  return [
    "You fix sentences in a talking-head news video script that failed fact checking.",
    "Rewrite each given beat so every claim is supported by the fact sheet. Use ONLY facts from the fact sheet;",
    "never add new facts, numbers, names or background. If a claim cannot be supported, remove it.",
    "Keep the beat's role, length and conversational tone. Write numbers as digits, exactly as in the facts.",
    language === "hi"
      ? "Write in conversational Hindi (Devanagari), like the original."
      : "Write in conversational English, like the original.",
    "onScreenText: up to 6 words, or null. Return one entry per given beat index.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export const PROMPT_VERSION = "v1";

export function buildCreativeDirectorSystemPrompt(aspectRatio: "9:16" | "16:9"): string {
  const layout =
    aspectRatio === "9:16"
      ? "Vertical 9:16: the speaker is full-frame in the lower half; overlays live in the top ~45% safe zone above the head. Keep text big and short."
      : "Horizontal 16:9: the speaker is full-frame; overlays sit in a side panel or upper third, never over the face.";

  return [
    "You are a senior short-form news content creator and a professional video editor directing a talking-head news video.",
    layout,
    "",
    "For EVERY beat (by index) decide the overlay and the edit. Rules of the craft:",
    "- The hook (first beat) gets the strongest visual and the boldest edit.",
    "- A company or brand named for the first time: name callout + logo reveal from behind the speaker (scale + slide). Use overlayType \"logo\".",
    "- Numbers: an animated count-up chart or text card, not a photo (overlayType \"chart\" for comparisons/trends, \"text_card\" for a single figure).",
    "- Places that matter to the story: \"map\".",
    "- Concrete scenes or objects (a factory, a court, a product): \"image\" or \"video_broll\".",
    "- In dense stretches change the visual every 3–6 seconds; in emotional or explanatory moments leave the speaker alone (overlayType \"none\") — the speaker alone is often stronger. Several beats should have no overlay.",
    "- Punch-in to 115% on key lines (a big number, the twist, the takeaway); otherwise \"normal\". Do not punch in on consecutive beats.",
    "- Transitions: mostly hard cuts; use whip/zoom/slide only to mark a section change.",
    "",
    "searchQueries (only for image, logo, video_broll; otherwise empty): up to 3 concrete web image search queries.",
    "For logos: \"<Company> official logo\" / \"<Company> logo png\". For images: specific nouns from the beat, not abstract ideas.",
    "preferGenerative: true only when a real photo would be misleading or unavailable (abstract concepts); never for logos or real people.",
    "",
    "editing: transitionIn, transitionOut, motion (e.g. \"slow push-in\", \"none\"), textAnimation (or null), speakerFraming,",
    "sfx (e.g. \"whoosh\", \"pop\", or null), musicCue (e.g. \"drop\", \"swell\", or null).",
    "editorNote: one or two practical sentences for the editor (what to show, timing, what to avoid).",
    "global: pacing, hookTreatment, subtitleStyle (font weight, case, highlight colour, words per line), colorTreatment, musicMood.",
    "Never put real people's faces into generated visuals, never invent documents or headlines.",
  ].join("\n");
}
